svg.text: 1 pages · light + dark · dashed strips are mock annotations, not product UI

g.title: Q-01-light — Query workbench (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/query · none · succeeded execution shown (time, rows, bytes); empty, running, cancelled and failed states occur at the results position — the failed sample carries WYRD-QUERY-COLUMN-UNKNOWN; safety floor: authorization, one SELECT, timeout, function, row and byte ceilings; catalog → schema → table → column explorer

g.text: Read one authorized SELECT against the tenant's own Bifrost data.
SELECT service_name, status_code, count(*) AS n,
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200
⌘⏎ runs · no saved worksheets, no second tab — the editor holds exactly one statement.
read-only · no chart, no export pipeline
4 of 4 rows · 1.8 MiB scanned — well inside both ceilings. Wide results scroll inside this panel only.
A failed run shows a safe structured error (code, identifier, remedy — never a stack trace or query plan).
history keeps this session's runs: q_01 failed · q_02 cancelled · q_03 succeeded · q_04 running
